title: Backup choices
decision: All backup timers run on the standby, where the repository is; pgBackRest between the hosts goes over SSH on the private link; point-in-time recovery is kept 14 to 21 days because pgBackRest cannot express exactly 14; monthly copies for 12 months are encrypted dumps, a snapshot and not point-in-time recovery; files are copied every five minutes rather than continuously; a missing backup alerts after 26 hours and a stale archive reaches the phone; the quarterly rehearsal and a third location are not covered
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 61
rationale: The operations document gives the retention and the schedule, not how each is met with the tool
